title: Tekshiruv: Service’lar
description: To’rtta Service turi va ular trafikni qanday yo’naltirishi bo’yicha beshta savol.

q1-clusterip.prompt: ClusterIP turidagi Service sizga nima beradi?

options.text: Faqat klaster ichidan murojaat qilinadigan barqaror virtual IP

q1-clusterip.explanation: ClusterIP - standart tur va asosiy qurilish g’ishti: NodePort ham, LoadBalancer ham uning ustiga quriladi.

q2-nodeport-range.explanation: API serverdagi --service-node-port-range bilan o’zgartirish mumkin, lekin kutiladigan diapazon - 30000-32767.

q3-endpoints.prompt: Service Pod’larni tanlaydi, lekin trafikni hech qayerga yubormayapti. Avval nimani tekshirasiz?

options.text: Uning EndpointSlice’larini - selektorga mos keladigan tayyor (Ready) Pod bormi

q3-endpoints.explanation: `kubectl get endpointslices -l kubernetes.io/service-name=<svc>`. Bo’sh bo’lsa - selektor birorta ham tayyor Pod’ga mos kelmayapti.

q4-expose.prompt: web nomli Deployment’ni 80-portda ClusterIP turidagi Service sifatida ochadigan buyruqni yozing.
q4-expose.explanation: Konteyner boshqa portni tinglayotgan bo’lsa, `--target-port` ni qo’shing.

options.text: Headless Service: VIP’siz, DNS to’g’ridan-to’g’ri Pod IP’larini qaytaradi

q5-headless.explanation: StatefulSet’lar har bir Pod’ga o’zining alohida hal qilinadigan nomini aynan headless Service orqali beradi.
